mortgage_calc_subtitle: A quick check of your eligibility for a subsidised housing loan.
mortgage_calc_intro: This calculator gives a preliminary estimate only. Final eligibility is decided by the Ministry of Aliyah & Integration and the Ministry of Construction & Housing, and may be higher or lower than this estimate.
mortgage_result_step_documents: Prepare your oleh certificate or community-affiliation confirmation, the last three months of payslips, and bank statements.
mortgage_result_step_advisor: Speak with a community-vetted mortgage advisor — we'll connect you.
mortgage_result_step_bank: Submit your application to a bank that participates in the programme.
mortgage_result_ineligible_title: You may not be eligible on this track
mortgage_reason_origin_not_eligible: This programme is for olim from Ethiopia and their children.
mortgage_reason_income_too_high: Monthly income is higher than the threshold we recommend pre-screening at (the official programme has no income ceiling — talk to an advisor).
mortgage_disclaimer_body: 200 entitlements per year, decided by lottery. Registration is ₪70 at a Bank Leumi branch. This is an estimator only — for an official check see
mortgage_disclaimer_link: the Ministry of Aliyah & Integration site
mortgage_how_works_registration_title: 1. Register at a Bank Leumi branch (₪70)
mortgage_how_works_registration_body: The programme starts with a ₪70 registration at a Bank Leumi branch. Registration is open in a defined window each year — follow the Ministry of Aliyah & Integration site for the dates.
mortgage_how_works_lottery_body: Of all registrants, 200 families win each year. If you don't win this year, you can register again the following year.
mortgage_how_works_approval_body: After winning the lottery, you go through legal verification of eligibility (oleh documents and no-prior-ownership confirmation) and then choose a property within the loan ceiling.
mortgage_how_works_contract_body: The contract is signed with a participating bank. Repayments: 0% interest for the first 10 years, 2% for the next 15, over a 25-year term.
